content.short: Rainbow.ag is a TON swap aggregator for finding better rates across thousands of supported tokens.
content.description: Rainbow.ag is a swap aggregator on TON. Its public page describes swapping TON and more than 2,500 tokens with best-rate routing and minimal price impact. It belongs in the DEX category because users come to it for token exchange and routing, not custody or portfolio tracking. Swap TON and 2500+ tokens at best rates and minimal price impact. Rainbow.ag belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface. Rainbow.ag gives TON users a practical path to deploy capital, route trades, manage liquidity, or interact with DeFi positions.
